_comment: RUN QUEUE P4 (docs/RUNQUEUE_pdfix_reask.md) - GPS+GALILEO on the working fold, 3 h.
Base is _ft63_gg12h.json (a STANDALONE GPS+Gal config), trimmed to 3 h + pd_safe.  It is
NOT the churn lineage, so the runs/pdfix_on comparison is CROSS-CONFIG: read it for
DIRECTION and for the GPS+Gal-specific quantities, never as a same-build A/B number.
(It does carry the same Card-4 posture: carry_invariant, q_z 1e-4, innov_gate +
calibrate window 15 - checked 2026-08-03.)
WHAT IT TESTS: the Aug-2 S-basis completion (project_network_ssystem_dia_assessment)
under a carry that finally works, with double the DD pool and double the iono sampling.
WATCH - this arm has a real structural risk the GPS-only arms do not: the joint pair
block K will EXCEED 686.  The whole defect was born of that block's near-singularity, so
track the pivot trajectory (ddfold_min_pivot_rel per epoch), ddfold_degen_* (must stay 0),
ddfold_repairs (a non-zero here would be the FIRST field exercise of INC-1c), and the
fold cost.  Also: datum/SBC health and PER-CONSTELLATION total_IF (their gauges differ -
chain_stability --sys G,E grades them separately and must never share a median).
P1-WINNER POSTURE ADDED 2026-08-03 eve: carry_invariant_innov_corroborate = true.  The
queue's own rule is 'winner becomes the base posture for P2-P6', and P2 / P3 / P3b / P6
all run it; without it this arm would differ from every other arm in TWO things at once
(constellation AND D5 policy) and no GPS+Gal difference would be attributable.  The base
_ft63_gg12h.json carries innov_gate + calibrate (window 15) but not corroborate, so this
is the only delta needed to line the D5 posture up with the rest of the matrix.
READ THE sigma0 STATE LINE (SPEC_pd_safe_dd_fold.md section 11).  A run-end 'sigma0 =
1.00x' WITHOUT a state histogram is a pre-fix exe; with one, check the histogram says
'active', not 'floored'.  A floored GPS+Gal run would mean the doubled DD pool is not
taking data - exactly the failure the giant-K risk above predicts.
